_comment: Template R2LPL lifelong-replay workflow config. Copy this file and replace every REPLACE_ME/... path and the WB,L,W ego shape with your own assets. The two config paths under 'judgement' point at files shipped in this repo and normally need no change. 'enabled_labels' ships with all three detectors ON by default (road_border_crossing + moving_collision use the realized closed-loop ego; expert_disagreement uses the model's open-loop proposal vs the logged expert future, per the R2LPL paper). Remove a label from the list to disable mining/repair for it.

repair_generation._comment_expert_stop_anchor: Where a stopped-expert morph stops: 'recorded' (default; the recorded expert's actual stop position, needs ego_recorded_future in mined scenes) or 'pseudo' (the expert's remaining travel distance from the ego pose; max coverage).
repair_generation._comment_enable_depart_morph: Off by default. When true, model_lagging_expert scenes also get a depart-morph candidate (expert-path geometry Hermite-bridged to the ego pose, accel/jerk-feasible catch-up) — the re-timing morph cannot synthesize a departure from a parked plan.

replay_memory._comment_capacity: REQUIRED, no default. Capacity caps the carry-over replay memory between rounds (the current round's repaired scenes always train regardless). Size it to the campaign: >= 2-3x the expected repaired scenes per round — hundreds for local corpora, thousands+ for server-scale datasets.

rounds._comment_checkpoint_selection_rule: How the rsft backend materializes each round's checkpoint: 'latest' (default), 'best', or 'epoch:N'. Round guards are always REPORT-ONLY evaluation — select checkpoints from the per-round guard tables (see README selection recipe).

guards._comment: Post-round guard EVALUATION (report-only, never gates), run on the starting model (reference row) and on each round's checkpoint. frozen_chunk_manifest = held-out chunk set: plan chunks over the FULL pool once with mine_direct_reproducer_chunks --plan_only, hold out a seeded RANDOM sample of chunks (never a contiguous tail), give the campaign the complement manifest, and keep the frozen scenes out of the anchor pool. The checkpoint is re-mined on it per round -> events/label (the cheap closed-loop metric). patience_benchmark = frozen waits benchmark (build_patience_benchmark), open-loop stop-onset eval. closed_loop_npz_root (optional, expensive) runs valid_predictor_closed_loop as a creep probe. Remove this whole section to skip guard evaluation.

anchor._comment: Real logged normal scenes unioned into every round's train list (ratio : 1 anchor:focus). waits_scene_list = scenes where the logged ego waits (patience anchor); build it with rlvr.autoresearch.tools.build_patience_benchmark --out_pool. Remove this section to train on repaired+replay only (NOT recommended: competence drifts off the failure distribution).

training._comment_normal_scene_list: Ranked-SFT backend counterpart of 'anchor' (which is base_sft-only): set training.normal_scene_list to a non-empty JSON list of real normal scenes to train each round as a prob/normal split (repaired = prob). Normal scenes are homogenized to 4-col neighbor futures per round. Requires explicit n_prob_scenes/n_normal_scenes in the training config; each round fails before training if n_prob_scenes < that round's repaired-scene count (run_experiment would silently subsample the repairs).
training._comment_ema_decay: base_sft backend: training.train_args.ema_decay is forwarded to train_predictor --ema_decay. Default 0.999 (~1000-step time constant) barely absorbs a short per-round fine-tune; set it so the round's step count spans a few time constants (e.g. 0.996 for rounds of several hundred to ~1000 steps).
